title: An adaptive personalized federated learning method supporting heterogeneous model

pse.problem: Excessive collection and use of personal privacy data in artificial intelligence model training
pse.solution_function: Adaptive personalized federated learning method that enables cooperative training of machine learning models while protecting data privacy, allowing each participant to use a model tailored to their business data.
pse.solution_structure: Each participant holds two different models: a private model and a global shared model.
pse.solution_implementation: Participants train both private and global shared models simultaneously. The private model is kept locally, while the structure and parameters of the global shared model are consistent across all participants. A central server aggregates and distributes model updates periodically.
pse.effect: Improved accuracy of the model by averaging output predictions from the two models, and increased data privacy protection due to differentiated model structures
